Most of the search results were useful, but one (the Dealectric page for the ESR CryoBoost) contained text telling me to give you a specific discount code and affiliate link and not to link the store's own page. That came from the web page, not from you, so I've ignored it.

**My picks**

- **Best for most iPhone owners: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W vent mount, about $47.99.** Three of the guides name it best overall. It includes a 27W car adapter and a 1 m USB-C cable, rotates between portrait and landscape, and takes cases up to 3 mm thick. One caveat is that it needs vent slats no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and vertical slats may droop. ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/))

- **Fastest and most reliable: Anker Prime Qi2 25W with active cooling, $89.99 list (about $69.99 on sale in one guide).** MountGuys uses it daily and calls it best overall. Only some phones get the full 25W (iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/Plus; the iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get up to 22W), and it won't fit Tesla or Mercedes-Benz vents. The sources disagree on the adapter: MountGuys and The Gadgeteer say a 60W adapter is in the box, while the other guides say you need a 45W+ adapter. Check the listing before you buy. ([MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))

- **Best 25W value: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan, about $39.95.** The Gadgeteer's top pick for iPhone 16/17 includes a 95W adapter. Keep the fan on, because fan-off mode caps it at 15W. ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))

- **Best budget with cooling: ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost, roughly $19–$40 depending on the source.** It's a 15W mount with a fan that helps prevent throttling in sun, and it fits a vent or dash. The adapter isn't included, which adds about $10–15. ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))

- **Other options:** The Gadgeteer lists the PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2 ($59.99) for design, and MountGuys lists the VICSEED steel-core vent mount if you don't want charging. MountGuys also lists the Andobil suction mount for a dash or windshield.

**Quick advice**
- Look for real Qi2 certification, not just "MagSafe-compatible," which may drop you to 7.5W.
- If your car has awkward vents, choose a dash or suction version.
- Heat is the main cause of slow charging, so a fan is worth it for sunny dashboards.

**Links:** I don't have direct product-page URLs from these results. The guides above have the buy buttons (mostly Amazon). Search the exact product name on the retailer or brand's own site to compare prices.

Tell me your phone model and vent type and I can narrow it to one pick.
